title: Customer Demand Letter and Receipt Reconciliation
summary: Match stage-linked demand letters with bank credits, home-loan disbursements, TDS certificates and GST, unit by unit, and give the CRM team an accurate statement of account.

seo.title: Demand Letter and Receipt Reconciliation AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that matches construction-linked demands with buyer payments, loan disbursements, TDS and GST, and prepares accurate unit-wise statements of account.

problem.intro: On a construction-linked plan, every slab or milestone triggers a demand to every buyer in that tower. The money comes back in pieces: buyer contributions, disbursements from several lenders, TDS deducted by the buyer and GST on each instalment. The CRM and accounts teams spend days matching credits to units before they can send an accurate statement or a reminder.

pain_points.title: Bank credits without a unit reference
pain_points.detail: Disbursements show only a lender's name or loan account, and buyer transfers carry a name that may not match the allottee.

pain_points.title: TDS gaps that look like shortfalls
pain_points.detail: When a buyer has deducted TDS but the certificate has not arrived, the unit looks short-paid and gets an incorrect reminder.

pain_points.title: Interest and GST errors
pain_points.detail: Interest on delayed payment, GST on each instalment and waivers agreed by sales are calculated in spreadsheets that drift from the agreement terms.

pain_points.title: Disputes at possession
pain_points.detail: Buyers challenge statements of account at possession or resale, and reconstructing years of demands and receipts pulls the team away from current collections.

solution.overview: We build a reconciliation engine that reads demand letters, payment plans, bank statements, lender disbursement advices, TDS certificates and receipts, and maintains a ledger per unit. It matches each credit to a unit using amounts, names, loan references, dates and open demands, and proposes the match with a confidence score. Credits it cannot place go to an unallocated queue with suggested units. It tracks pending TDS certificates against each deduction, computes interest and GST from terms configured from your agreement, and produces a statement of account and an overdue list. Accounts approve allocations and waivers before anything reaches a buyer.
capabilities: Reads demand letters, payment schedules, bank statements, lender disbursement advices and receipts
Matches credits to units using amount, payer name, loan account, date and open demands
Tracks buyer TDS deductions against Form 16B certificates received
Splits receipts into base price, GST and other charges as per your configuration
Calculates interest on delayed payment from configured agreement terms, with approved waivers applied
Generates unit-wise statements of account and overdue lists for reminders

workflow.title: Load demands and plans
workflow.detail: Payment plans, milestone dates and demand letters raised for each unit are imported from the CRM or read from PDFs.

workflow.title: Ingest receipts
workflow.detail: Bank statements, lender disbursement advices, cheque and UPI receipts and TDS certificates are read daily.

workflow.title: Match credits to units
workflow.detail: Each credit is matched to a unit and demand with a confidence score and the evidence for the match.

workflow.title: Route exceptions
workflow.detail: Low-confidence matches, unidentified credits and TDS gaps go to an accounts queue with suggested units.

workflow.title: Accounts approval
workflow.detail: An accountant confirms allocations, interest waivers and corrections, and the ledger updates.

workflow.title: Issue statements and reminders
workflow.detail: Approved statements of account are generated, and genuine overdues feed the reminder workflow.

inputs: Payment plans and milestone completion dates
Demand letters and cost sheets per unit
Lender disbursement advices and tripartite agreement details
Form 16B TDS certificates and buyer receipts
Agreed interest terms and approved waivers
outputs: Unit-wise ledger with matched demands and receipts

human_in_the_loop: Accountants approve every allocation below the confidence threshold, every interest calculation that leads to a charge and every waiver. Statements and reminders go out only after the CRM team has reviewed them.
integrations: Real estate CRM or ERP such as Salesforce, Sell.Do or Farvision
Bank statement downloads or bank APIs
Email and WhatsApp for statements and reminders
Shared drive for lender advices and TDS certificates
guardrails: No buyer communication without human approval
Interest and GST rules configured from your agreement and checked by finance
Every match stores its evidence: amount, reference and demand
Allocations are reversible, with a logged reason
Bank and identity data masked in logs
compliance_notes: Helps track TDS deducted by buyers on property purchases and the certificates they issue, as configured by your finance team.
Keeps receipts traceable by project and collection account, which supports the CA certification needed for withdrawals from the RERA project account.

pilot.scope: One tower, reconciling demands and receipts for a recent period from bank statements and CRM data, compared with the ledger your accounts team already maintains.
deliverables: Matching rules and interest configuration for the pilot tower
Reconciled unit ledgers and unallocated credit list
Draft statements of account for a sample of units
Comparison report against your existing ledger

faqs.q: Can it handle home loans from many different banks?
faqs.a: Yes. Disbursement advices and statement narrations differ by lender, so we build a resolver that learns each lender's reference format and links it to the buyer's loan account. New lenders are added as they appear.

faqs.q: Will it send reminders on its own?
faqs.a: No. It produces an overdue list that excludes units waiting only on a TDS certificate or an unallocated credit. Your CRM team approves the list before any reminder goes out.

faqs.q: How is interest on delayed payment calculated?
faqs.a: From the terms your finance and legal teams configure from the agreement, such as rate and calculation basis, with waivers applied once approved. Each calculation shows its inputs so it can be explained to a buyer.

faqs.q: Can it rebuild history for units sold years ago?
faqs.a: Yes, from historical bank statements, demands and receipts, though older scanned documents need more review. Many teams start with current towers and backfill older ones before possession.
